articles.summary: A first-of-its-kind whole genome map from researchers at Recursion with partners Roche and Genentech offers a new approach to exploring novel targets and pathways for a wide range of neurological diseases.
articles.title: How a First-of-its-Kind “Microglia Map” from Recursion and Roche and Genentech Could Unlock New Treatments for Neurodegenerative Diseases
